stem: During a school health review, a 7-year-old has a BMI at the 86th percentile for age; which finding is a growth flag that should prompt closer attention?

options.text: BMI above the 90th percentile only if height is average

explanation: BMI above the 85th percentile is the growth flag that should prompt closer attention.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because BMI above the 50th percentile is not the flagged threshold.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because the 75th percentile is not the threshold for closer attention.
optionExplanations.C: Correct because BMI above the 85th percentile is identified as a growth flag that warrants closer review.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because no extra condition about average height is required for this flag.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because the 95th percentile is a higher cutoff for obesity, not the earlier growth flag threshold.

sourceRefs: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
